svg.text: HTTP REQUEST LIFECYCLE · FASTIFY MIDDLEWARE STACK
WAFv2 inspects every request against 3 managed rule groups before it reaches Fastify.
ALB terminates TLS 1.3, injects X-Forwarded-For, forwards plain HTTP to port 3000.
Block by WAF → 403 returned by AWS infrastructure, Fastify never sees the request.
trustProxy: true in Fastify so req.ip reads from X-Forwarded-For (rate-limit key).
Hook 1: reply.header('x-request-id', req.id) / genReqId = X-Request-Id header ∥ randomUUID().
Hook 2: inject access-control-allow-* headers. OPTIONS preflight → 204 immediately.
If CORS_ORIGIN='*' in production → warn log (NFR1 flag). Set specific origin to harden.
Key: ratelimit:ip:{req.ip}:{class} / req.ip sourced from X-Forwarded-For via trustProxy.
credential class (login, refresh, reset): 10 burst cap · 10/min refill rate.
general class (signup): 30 burst cap · 30/min refill rate.
Redis unavailable: fail-CLOSED (503) on credential routes, fail-OPEN on general.
Hit: 429 + Retry-After header. Sets X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset on every response.
X-Api-Key present → authenticateApiKey(): SHA-256(key) lookup in api_keys table (ownerPool),
check revoked_at IS NULL, async UPDATE last_used_at. Sets req.auth.role = 'member' always.
Otherwise: Authorization: Bearer <jwt> → TokenService.verifyAccessToken() (HS256, jose lib).
Extracts { sub, tenant_id, role }. Iss: tenantforge, Aud: tenantforge-api. TTL max 900s.
Neither present → 401 UNAUTHORIZED before any handler runs. No DB touch for JWT path.
Key: ratelimit:{req.auth.tenantId} / plan fetched: SELECT plan FROM organizations (ownerPool).
free → 60 cap / 1 req/s starter → 300 cap / 5 req/s pro → 1000 cap / 16.7 req/s.
Sets X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset on every response.
Hit → 429 + Retry-After. Redis down → fail-CLOSED writes (503) / fail-OPEN reads.
appPool.connect() → BEGIN → set_config('app.current_tenant_id', tenantId, true) [txn-local GUC].
SELECT deleted_at FROM organizations WHERE id=$tenantId / if set → ROLLBACK + 403 Forbidden.
Sets req.db = PoolClient. All queries on req.db now auto-filtered by RLS policies (no WHERE needed).
onSend: status < 400 → COMMIT, else ROLLBACK. RESET app.current_tenant_id. client.release().
onError: always ROLLBACK + RESET + release. Fail-closed: unset GUC = NULL = zero rows returned.
Route handler: Zod validates body/params, requireRole() checks RBAC, service fn called via req.db.
onSend: status < 400 → COMMIT (durable write before client sees 200), else ROLLBACK.
Error handler: AppError → envelope, Zod .validation → 400, unknown → 500 (no stack leak).
